description:
Stop Luca drafting replies, running follow-up cadences, and sending campaign messages to one lead, for 1h, 24h, 7d, 30d, or until resumed. A draft in flight stops at its next step. Opt-outs and crisis messages are still handled. Pausing again replaces the earlier pause. A timed pause resumes the lead by itself when it ends.

Luca operation: POST /api/leads/{id}/drafting/pause
Required scopes: leads:write
Required OAuth scope: luca:queue_ops; data sensitivity: redacted
Requires Idempotency-Key. Provide idempotencyKey for safe retries, or the server will generate one.
Use workspaceId or workspaceSlug to override the default workspace configured by environment.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable key for safe retries. If omitted, the MCP server generates a unique key for this call.

name: luca_leads_drafting_pause
title: Pause Luca for a lead
